name: Charge Type 14 Code
definition: Identifies charges linked to the type of service.

ADRF.name: ADR Fee
ADRF.definition: Charge linked to an ADR (American Depositary Receipt).

ISSC.name: Issuance Cancellation Fee
ISSC.definition: Fee linked to the cancellation of an issuance.

CUST.name: Custody Fee
CUST.definition: Fee paid to a custodian in respect of custodial services.

CHAR.name: Service Provision Fee
CHAR.definition: Fee paid for the provision of financial services.

ISSU.name: Issuance Fee
ISSU.definition: Charge linked to the issuance of security.
